findings.text: Acceptance 3: search continuation loses matches. Reproduced against in-memory real routes with six matching messages: search({q:'needle',limit:2,skip:0/2/4/6}) returned [5,6], [5,6], [5,6], []; the completeness assertion failed (2 !== 6). The server returns its newest N matches ascending, so increasing N then slice(skip) repeatedly selects the same tail. Paginate in a consistent order and add coverage asserting every ID is reached when matches exceed limit.
